hero.h1: We buy fruit and dry fruit directly from growers and dealers.
hero.subline: Transparent digital weighing, direct farm inspection, and immediate bank settlement for your harvest.

trust.payment: Direct bank settlement upon inspection & digital weighing

farmers.title: A fair deal for every crate and quintal.

steps.title: Tell us what you have
steps.desc: Fill our digital weighing slip below or message our export desk with your crop variety, estimated quantity, and farm location.

steps.title: Farm inspection & custom quote
steps.desc: We evaluate crop quality, berry size, brix sweetness, and grade at your farm or centre and offer a confirmed direct purchase quote.

steps.title: Farm pickup or centre delivery
steps.desc: Bring your crates to our Manerajuri packhouse or arrange direct farm pickup across our primary sourcing belts.

steps.title: Direct bank payment
steps.desc: Transparent electronic weighing at the scale. Immediate payment transfer to your verified bank account upon grading.

slip.title: Register your farm lot & generate an official inquiry slip
slip.receipt_payment_val: Immediate Direct Bank Transfer upon Weighing
slip.receipt_disclaimer: Individual purchase rates are offered following physical quality inspection, brix sweetness measurement, and certified digital weighing.

items.heading: Honest Digital Scale
items.text: Every crate is weighed on calibrated electronic platform scales in your presence. No arbitrary deductions.

items.heading: Direct Bank Settlement
items.text: Electronic fund transfer directly to your bank account upon grading and issue of verified weighing receipt.

items.heading: Farm Gate Collection
items.text: Scheduled refrigerated transport and pickup from farm gates across Sangli and Solapur horticulture clusters.

items.heading: Objective Grading Standards
items.text: Clear berry size, color, brix sweetness, and defect thresholds explained upfront before unloading.

products.title: Fresh fruits & premium dry fruits we buy for export
products.subtitle: We partner with local growers of high-grade horticultural produce meeting domestic and overseas standards.

items.name: California & Mamra Almonds

items.packing: 25kg / 50kg sealed nitrogen flushed bags or vacuum sacks

items.name: Royal Medjool Dates
items.description: Large, succulent caramel-textured dates sourced for seasonal Ramadan and festive distribution.

items.name: Raw & Processed Cashew Kernels
items.description: Whole white cashew kernels procured from Konkan and coastal processing units.
items.grades: W210, W240, W320 whole white kernels
